programme.title: Ridiculousness: Chanel and Sterling LVI
programme.desc: I et nyt afsnit af Ridiculousness fejrer Rob, Chanel og Steelo ældre mennesker i 'Den mest liderlige generation', tjekker nogle børn ud, der ville have det 'Bedre uden forældre' og ser, hvordan man giver 'Ekstra 10 procent'.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: Amber og Gary løser omsider deres myndighedstvist om Leah. Farrah planlægger at flytte til LA, men er usikker på sit forhold til Simon. Catelynn og Tyler overvejer at få et barn mere, og mødrene rejser til LA.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: Farrahs mor konfronterer Simon til Sophias 7-års fødselsdag. Amber håndterer det seneste medierygte om Matt. Catelynns depression kommer tilbage, og hun søger hjælp hos dr. Drew.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: Maci og Taylor opdager, at den uventede graviditet er mere fremskreden, end de troede. Matt tager Amber med til sin hjemby, hvor hun møder hans familiemedlemmer.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 503
programme.desc: Tina og Danni solgte deres rækkehus i troen på, at de nok hurtigt ville finde det rette hus. Men nej. Parret er superkræsne, og har høje krav. Kan eksperterne skabe det hjem, Tina og Danni drømmer om?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 504
programme.desc: Laura og Jesper og Jespers to børn bor til leje i Humlebæk, og det er de mildest talt trætte af. De mangler plads, have – og de vil også gerne have børn sammen snart. Men to års boligjagt har ikke givet bonus.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 505
programme.desc: Ulla og Kristian bor i en smuk herskabslejlighed på Frederiksberg med deres to børn. Men de ønsker sig mere plads i et børnevenligt kvarter i cykelafstand til indre by. Kan Tobias Edlev-Nielsen finde et hus til dem?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 506
programme.desc: En lille lejebolig i Vanløse og to små børn – det er ikke det bedste match. Lisa og Erling drømmer om et stort hus med stor have. Tobias kommer på hårdt arbejde, for drømmene er en hel del større end budgettet.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 703
programme.desc: Caféen i Aalborg kører slet ikke rundt. En forretning udelukkende baseret på billige deal-gæster, truer med at slå bunden ud af det unge forpagter-pars økonomi.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 704
programme.desc: På Da Carmine har de en vaskeægte napolitansk kok! Men problemet er bare, at han har mistet passionen for at lave ægte italiensk mad.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 705
programme.desc: I de smukkeste omgivelser i Korsør lystskov ligger restaurant Sommerlyst. Stedet er drevet af Jesper og Yvonne, der 4 måneder inde i deres forpagtning, allerede er ved at kaste håndklædet i ringen.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 706
programme.desc: Restaurant Limone drives af ægteparret Johnny og Helle. Restauranten, der ligger inde i en biograf, kæmper med at få gæster til at komme og spise - og ikke bare gå i biografen.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 501
programme.desc: På Gesten Kro er forpagteren Tim på 34 år magtesløs. Aften efter aften står restauranten tom, og når der endelig kommer gæster, bliver de ikke længere end højest nødvendigt.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 502
programme.desc: På Orø Kro har de et blakket ry. De lokale holder sig væk, og en madanmelder har for nylig givet restauranten to stjerner i en landsdækkende avis.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Season 1 Reunion
programme.desc: Otte unge festglade mennesker i ét hus kombineret med masser af strand, fest og farver er omdrejningspunktet i 'Jersey Shore'. Realityshowet har skabt debat over hele verden og blevet nævnt af selveste Barack Obama.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Goin' South
programme.desc: Jersey Shore banden tager til Miami! Imens at The Situation, Snooki, Pauly D og JWOWW tager en road trip ned til østkysten, hopper resten af gruppen på et fly for at tage vinteren i syden.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Hangover
programme.desc: Sammi prøver at finde ud af hvad Ronnie lavede på natklubben aftenen før, men der er ingen som siger noget. Da Angelina afbryder Paulys game, ser vi en helt ny side, af en ellers meget rolig Pauly D!

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Creepin'
programme.desc: Angelina må sluge sin stolthed og sige undskyld til pigerne. I huset hygger The Situation, Vinny og Pauly D sig i boblebadet, mens Ronnie fortsætter med at krybe bag Sammi ryg.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Breaking Up
programme.desc: Ronnies dårlige opførsel sætter Snooki, Angelina og JWOWW i en svær situation. Pigerne bliver sammen enige om at skrive et anonymt brev til Sammi, for en gang for alle at afsløre hele sandheden om Ronnie for hende.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Letter
programme.desc: Sammi finder Snooki og JWOWWs 'anonyme' brev, og denne gang er det for alvor slut mellem Ronnie og hende - i hvert fald indtil videre. I mellemtiden har Mike, Vinny og Pauly deres hænder fulde, da de har gang i fire piger på en aften.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Best Of Geordie Tours
programme.desc: Vi ser tilbage på den bedste sæson af Geordie Shore. Slænget afslører, hvad de mente om deres druktur gennem Europa. Plus: aldrig viste scener med drengene og pigerne som du aldrig har set dem før!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Family Means Family
programme.desc: Gruppen er I højt humør, da et overraskende besøg fra Jay betyder nogle dage med non-stop fester. Charlotte bakser stadig med sine følelser for Gaz, Vicky begynder at date, mens James' strid med Holly fortsætter.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: House Divides
programme.desc: James og Gaz kommer op at skændes over scoringer og alle deltager i et eksplosivt skænderi, som ender med, at Gaz må forlade huset. Men er bortvisning en dårlig ting?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Vicky Meets Dan
programme.desc: Den flotteste fyr i Australien gør pigerne helt kulrede, og Scotty og Gaz puster sig op, når det går hårdt for sig på natklubben. Husødelæggelser får Gary sendt ud i bushen og Charlotte får en åbenbaring.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Gruppen får en lektion i vredeshåndtering og Charlotte lukker alle de negative følelser ud, som hun har for Gaz. Sophie og Joel bliver stangstive på en bytur og gør resten af gruppen forlegne.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: James og Gary ryger i totterne på hinanden og sender chokbølger gennem huset, og Charlottes hjerte åbner sig for Gary, når hun tilbyder ham sin støtte. Og en hemmeligt singletur til Whitsundays ender katastrofalt.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Cesar and the Horse Whisperer (Chloe & Hobo, Ali)
programme.desc: Cesar enlists the help of Horse Whisperer Pat Parelli at a riding center that works with special needs people. A dog with separation anxiety exhibits extreme dog aggression.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Inside Puppy Mills
programme.desc: This powerful episode delves into the horror of puppy mills and the rescue and rehab of traumatized pups by the Last Chance for Animals non-profit organization.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Nuna & Kane
programme.desc: NuNu the Chihuahua, fiercely attacks anyone who comes near his owner Tina. NuNu’s total opposite, Kane the Great Dane, is vehemently afraid of shiny surfaces

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Opie & Flirt
programme.desc: Black lab mix Opie is a charmer around people, but frighteningly aggressive around other dogs. Energetic to the point of being neurotic, Chinese Crested Flirt cannot sit still for one moment.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Rana & Ruby
programme.desc: Scared of everything, Ruby the Vischla deals with her neuroses by biting. At the same time, Rana barks every time bread pops in the toaster, or when the microwave goes off, or when the phone rings.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Josh & Boomer
programme.desc: Josh, a Maltese, will not let anyone with a brush or pair of scissors near him without putting up a fight. Boomer, a Chesapeake Bay Retriever, barks incessantly and refuses to come out of the pool.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Harry & Brooks
programme.desc: Harry wants to charge after anything with wheels, including passing cyclists, rollerbladers or skateboarders. Brooks, an Entlebucher, is constantly chasing after light, he is never calm.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Coach & Sueki
programme.desc: Coach, an out of control Boxer, bit a neighbor, seemingly sealing his fate. Coach gets a stay of execution when Cesar Millan comes to the rescue. Sueki refuses to walk on the leash.

programme.title: Hundehviskeren: Slick & Pepper
programme.desc: Slick, a rare white Puli, is full of phobias. When clients come to Christopher’s photography studio, they are greeted by Pepper’s annoying barking and heel nipping.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty
programme.desc: Willie becomes concerned about Rebecca's future when she returns from her internship in Los Angeles; sick Uncle Si makes himself at home in Phil and Ms. Kay's living room.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty
programme.desc: Korie's job-seeking cousin, JD, tries to befriend the guys in the Duck Call room; Uncle Si baby-sits Jep's children and leads them on an unusual treasure hunt.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty
programme.desc: Uncle Si annoys the guys when he uses a digital camera to document a day in his life; Willie improvises when he gets lost driving John Luke and Sadie to a college football game.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty
programme.desc: The guys battle distractions as they attempt to complete an order before sunrise; Mia and Priscilla seek revenge on Phil after he scares them with a ghost story.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty
programme.desc: Willie and Jase compete to determine who can cook the better burger; a visit to the junkyard leads to quality bonding time for Phil and Jep; Jessica and Kay enjoy decoupage.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty

programme.title: 21 Jump Street

programme.title: 21 Jump Street

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tagging a Suspect
programme.desc: Bombings are difficult to solve because the perpetrator isn't usually at the scene and the evidence goes up in smoke. In this case, pieces of plastic the size of grains of sand hold the key to finding a murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cereal Killer
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crash Course

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg Up On Crime
programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tight-Fitting Genes

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Valentine

programme.title: Forensic Files: Picture This

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fateful Twist
programme.desc: A southeastern Virginia community is stunned by a crime no one can believe. A pregnant woman murdered, her baby lost. Across the state, another town feels a similar shock, a brutal, random slaying in a most unexpected setting.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished
programme.desc: In New York, an ambitious college student has her whole life ahead of her, until she crosses the path of a killer. It's a random murder, the hardest kind to solve.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness
programme.desc: George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Failed 5 Times?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: 12 Years a Fugitive

programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Fermi Paradox
